source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Importing shared widget styles can collide with component-local classes. D212377 broke address-book edit icons because private icon-button rules collided with widget.css. The temporary button-icon rename repaired that landing. Review requested shared widgets.css and containers.css reuse, and the current accepted header uses generic icon-button and sidebar-panel-header. Prefer current shared styles for new controls. Inspect editor/templates as well as the changed header. Do not adopt the temporary rename as a lasting naming rule.
title: Reuse shared widget classes and check every existing consumer before importing CSS
